text_1_facilitator.eng: Today, you will learn how one-on-one time works. Let’s begin with a question for our learning.

quiz_1_question.eng: True or False: When I spend special time with my child, I need to have a plan. I need to know what we will do together.

quiz_1_feedback_1.eng:
❌ That is not correct. 

🧸 You do not have to plan an activity. Your child can lead! Let them choose as long as it is safe. This will increase their confidence and make it more likely that they enjoy their time with you.

quiz_1_feedback_2.eng:

🧸 Your child can choose the activity as long as it is safe. This will increase their confidence and make it more likely that they enjoy their time with you.

text_1_facilitator.eng:
I will also provide you with tips that you can use anytime and anywhere!

3️⃣ Here are three tips to remember when spending one-on-one time with your child: DAY, PLAY, and STAY.

section_1_text.eng:
Try to do it every day

⏰ Spend 5 minutes (or more!) with your child each day

section_2_text.eng:
Let them choose the activity

⏰ Ask to spend time with your child.
⚽ Let them choose what to do or talk about.
🎈Try different activities together.
😃 Have fun!

section_3_text.eng:
Focus on your child

📺 Switch off the TV, put aside phones, and remove distractions.
👀 Look at your child. Nod or say “I see” to show you are really paying attention. 
💛 Accept your child and avoid judgement.
💡 Respond to your child when they communicate with you. your child may use gestures, full sentences, movements, and sounds to communicate with you. It shows you are really paying attention to them.
